name: mmbl.io voice-to-task app landing page by mmbl.io
description: A dark, type-led landing page for a voice-capture task app, built on a near-black canvas with a single lavender editorial interstitial that resets the rhythm mid-page. Every section repeats a disciplined pattern: a two-line display headline (second line knocked back to gray or accented in periwinkle), a small right-aligned supporting paragraph, then a media moment — a tilted phone mockup wrapped in organic colour blobs, a side-by-side capture/parse demo, or a mockup paired with stacked feature blocks. Density stays low with generous whitespace; colour is rationed to small doses (waveform bars, pill tags, glyphs) against #0b0c10 panels, slightly lighter cards, and pill-shaped buttons with soft radii and no decorative shadows. The colourful waveform mark is the only recurring graphic motif, tying voice capture to brand identity down to the footer.
